presentation.label: Apply Scene
presentation.summary: Hold SCENE A or SCENE B and press YES: the sound the crossfader blends right now becomes the active Part's base sound.
presentation.overview: Morph between the two scenes with the crossfader, stop where it sounds right, and keep that sound. APPLY SCENE writes the blended value of every parameter either scene locks into the active Part, as if you had turned each knob there yourself. The scenes, the crossfader and the saved Part stay as they were, so the scenes keep morphing from the new base and RELOAD PART takes you back to the last saved Part.
highlights: Covers every scene-lockable page on all eight audio tracks: SRC (the assigned machine), LFO speed and depth, AMP, FX1 and FX2.
The value written is the one stock's scene morph plays at the current crossfader position, rounded to the nearest knob step.
A muted scene counts as not locked, exactly as stock morphs it.
Nothing new is stored: the result is ordinary Part data that saves, loads and survives a power cycle like a hand-turned knob.
usage: Lock some parameters in SCENE A and SCENE B, move the crossfader to the blend you want, then hold SCENE A (or SCENE B) and press YES. SCENE APPLIED confirms it.
Save the Part to keep it, or press FUNC + CUE (RELOAD PART) to go back to the last saved Part.

limitations: SCENE A or B held + YES no longer shows ARM ALL; YES alone still does.
The crossfader stays where it is: a parameter locked in only one scene moves when you apply, because stock now blends that lock with the new base. A parameter locked in both scenes does not move.
XVOL and XLV (the crossfader volume locks) have no Part knob and stay scene locks.
Trig locks and LFO modulation are not written into the Part; the result is the sound on steps without a trig lock.
With MASTER TRACK on, track 8's SRC and AMP scene locks are not applied: stock has no knob there.
Not in MIDI mode, and not on MIDI tracks (stock has no scene locks there).
Undo is stock RELOAD PART, which also discards any other unsaved edits since the last Part save.
Emulator-tested only; not yet run on hardware.

storage.label: Storage
storage.display: 448 bytes of ColdFire code in the image's free run; no DSP code, no saved data
storage.conditions: Linked unit size reported by the native build of the apply-scene-stock remix.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.display: None while idle; one apply runs about 2.3 to 5.5 million ColdFire instructions in the UI task
processing.conditions: ot_emu, instructions from the YES press to the toast for 106 to 160 parameter writes; no DSP work. Hardware time not measured.

tests.summary: verify.py under ot_emu (MKII): the applied Part equals the stock morph model at five fader positions, with scene mutes, on all machine types and stock FX pairs; the saved Part, scenes and fader stay untouched; RELOAD PART, Part save, project save and reload and a power cycle keep it. No hardware run yet.

access.location: Any audio-track page, with SCENE A or SCENE B held.
steps: Lock parameters in SCENE A and SCENE B as usual (hold the scene key and turn knobs).
Move the crossfader to the blend you want to keep.
Hold SCENE A or SCENE B and press YES: SCENE APPLIED.
Save the Part to keep the result, or RELOAD PART (FUNC + CUE) to undo.
